_source: Ported from Llamacpp-Model-Launcher parameters_db.py (MIT, (c) 2025 Kaspur2012), synced with llama-server b11723

parameters.name: GPU Layers
parameters.description: Max. number of layers to store in VRAM: an exact number, 'auto' (let --fit decide) or 'all' (default: auto). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_N_GPU_LAYERS

parameters.name: Split Mode
parameters.description: How to split the model across GPUs. layer (default): split layers and KV (pipelined). tensor: split weights and KV across GPUs and run them in parallel (EXPERIMENTAL, often the fastest with 2+ identical GPUs). row: split weight rows (parallelized). none: one GPU only. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPLIT_MODE

parameters.name: Tensor Split
parameters.description: Fraction of the model to offload to each GPU, comma-separated proportions, e.g. 3,1. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_TENSOR_SPLIT

parameters.name: Main GPU
parameters.description: GPU used for the model (split-mode none) or for intermediate results and KV (split-mode row) (default: 0). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_MAIN_GPU

parameters.name: Device
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of devices to use for offloading, e.g. CUDA0,CUDA1 (none = don't offload). Use --list-devices to see them. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_DEVICE

parameters.name: List Devices
parameters.description: Print list of available devices and exit

parameters.name: Fit To Memory
parameters.description: Automatically adjust UNSET arguments (-ngl, -c, -ts, -ncmoe...) so the model fits in device memory (default: on). Set 'off' when you tune those values yourself. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_FIT

parameters.name: Fit Target Margin
parameters.description: Free-memory margin per device (MiB) that --fit leaves untouched. Comma list per device or a single value for all (default: 1024). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_FIT_TARGET

parameters.name: Fit Min Context
parameters.description: Minimum context size that --fit is allowed to set (default: 4096). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_FIT_CTX

parameters.name: Override Tensor
parameters.description: Override tensor buffer type: <tensor name pattern>=<buffer type>,... e.g. "blk\.(3[0-9])\.ffn_.*_exps=CPU". Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_OVERRIDE_TENSOR

parameters.name: CPU MoE
parameters.description: Keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CPU_MOE

parameters.name: N CPU MoE
parameters.description: Keep the MoE expert weights of the first N layers in the CPU. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_N_CPU_MOE

parameters.name: MoE Expert Cache (MiB)
parameters.description: NEW (v0.7.0): GPU cache in MiB for the MoE experts kept in the CPU (-cmoe / -ncmoe). With several GPUs it is split among them like the layers (-ts). Up to ~2x faster generation when experts are offloaded; costs VRAM (default: 0, disabled). Experimental. The Tuning Wizard sweep can test it. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_MOE_CACHE_MIB

parameters.name: N CPU FFN (Dense)
parameters.description: NEW: keep the dense FFN weights of the first N layers in the CPU (dense models; the -ncmoe equivalent for non-MoE). Usually faster than lowering -ngl because attention stays on the GPU. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_N_CPU_FFN

parameters.name: No KV Offload
parameters.description: Keep the KV cache in system RAM instead of VRAM (default: KV offload enabled). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_KV_OFFLOAD

parameters.name: No Host Buffer
parameters.description: Bypass the host buffer, allowing extra buffer types to be used. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_NO_HOST

parameters.name: No Op Offload
parameters.description: Disable offloading host tensor operations to the device (default: op offload enabled). Can help prompt speed with heavy CPU offload.

parameters.name: RPC Servers
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of RPC servers (host:port) to offload to remote machines. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_RPC

parameters.name: Context Size
parameters.description: Size of the prompt context (default: 0 = loaded from model). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CTX_SIZE

parameters.name: Batch Size
parameters.description: Logical maximum batch size (default: 2048). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_BATCH

parameters.name: UBatch Size
parameters.description: Physical maximum batch size (default: 512). Bigger values (1024/2048) usually speed up prompt processing at the cost of VRAM. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_UBATCH

parameters.name: Flash Attention
parameters.description: Flash Attention ('on', 'off' or 'auto', default: auto). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_FLASH_ATTN

parameters.name: Cache Type K
parameters.description: KV cache data type for K (default: f16). q8_0 halves KV memory with minimal quality loss. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_TYPE_K

parameters.name: Cache Type V
parameters.description: KV cache data type for V (default: f16). Quantized V needs Flash Attention. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_TYPE_V

parameters.name: Parallel Slots
parameters.description: Number of server slots (default: -1 = auto). Use 1 for a single user to get all the context in one slot. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_N_PARALLEL

parameters.name: KV Unified
parameters.description: Use a single unified KV buffer shared across all sequences (default: enabled if number of slots is auto). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_KV_UNIFIED

parameters.name: No KV Unified
parameters.description: Force a separate KV buffer per slot. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_KV_UNIFIED

parameters.name: KV Unified Per Slot
parameters.description: Context limit per parallel slot. When set without -c, the shared KV pool is sized to n_parallel*N. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_KV_UNIFIED_PER_SLOT

parameters.name: SWA Full
parameters.description: Use full-size SWA cache (default: false). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SWA_FULL

parameters.name: No Repack
parameters.description: Disable CPU weight repacking (default: repacking enabled). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_REPACK

parameters.name: Performance Timings
parameters.description: Enable internal libllama performance timings (default: false). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_PERF

parameters.name: Load Mode
parameters.description: Model loading mode (replaces --mmap/--no-mmap/--mlock). auto: mmap unless a device does not support it. none: read into memory (old --no-mmap). mmap: memory-map. mlock: keep in RAM. mmap+mlock. dio: DirectIO, fastest loading from NVMe when fully offloaded. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_LOAD_MODE

parameters.name: Lazy Mode
parameters.description: On-demand reading of certain tensors (e.g. per-layer embeddings). on: read rows from disk on demand (requires mmap). auto: on only for tensors > 4 GiB. off: keep resident. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_LAZY_MODE

parameters.name: NUMA
parameters.description: Attempt optimizations that help on some NUMA systems. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_NUMA

parameters.name: Check Tensors
parameters.description: Check model tensor data for invalid values (default: false)

parameters.name: Override KV
parameters.description: Override model metadata by key, comma-separated. Types: int, float, bool, str. Example: tokenizer.ggml.add_bos_token=bool:false

parameters.name: Threads
parameters.description: Number of CPU threads used during generation (default: -1 = auto). With CPU offload, the number of P-cores is usually best on hybrid Intel CPUs. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_THREADS

parameters.name: Threads Batch
parameters.description: Number of threads used during batch and prompt processing (default: same as --threads)

parameters.name: CPU Mask
parameters.description: CPU affinity mask: arbitrarily long hex. Complements cpu-range (default: "")

parameters.name: CPU Range
parameters.description: Range of CPUs for affinity. Complements --cpu-mask. Format: lo-hi

parameters.name: CPU Strict
parameters.description: Use strict CPU placement (default: 0)

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Process/thread priority: low(-1), normal(0), medium(1), high(2), realtime(3) (default: 0)

parameters.name: Poll
parameters.description: Polling level to wait for work (0 - no polling, default: 50)

parameters.name: CPU Mask Batch
parameters.description: CPU affinity mask for batch processing (default: same as --cpu-mask)

parameters.name: CPU Range Batch
parameters.description: Ranges of CPUs for batch affinity. Complements --cpu-mask-batch

parameters.name: CPU Strict Batch
parameters.description: Strict CPU placement for batch (default: same as --cpu-strict)

parameters.name: Priority Batch
parameters.description: Batch process/thread priority: 0-normal, 1-medium, 2-high, 3-realtime (default: 0)

parameters.name: Poll Batch
parameters.description: Use polling to wait for batch work (default: same as --poll)

parameters.name: Speculative Type
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of speculative decoding types (default: none). draft-mtp: use the model's own Multi-Token-Prediction head (Qwen3.x/GLM/DeepSeek "MTP" GGUFs, no extra model). draft-simple: classic draft model (-md). draft-eagle3 / draft-dflash / draft-dspark: special draft heads. ngram-*: no extra model, great for code edits and repetitive text. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_TYPE

parameters.name: Draft Max Tokens
parameters.description: Number of tokens to draft per step (default: 3). Replaces the removed --draft/--draft-max. MTP usually peaks at 2-4. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_MAX

parameters.name: Draft Min Tokens
parameters.description: Minimum number of draft tokens (default: 0). Replaces the removed --draft-min. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_MIN

parameters.name: Draft P Min
parameters.description: Minimum speculative decoding probability (greedy) (default: 0.00). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_P_MIN

parameters.name: Draft Sampling
parameters.description: How the draft is sampled: greedy takes its argmax, probabilistic samples it and has the target verify by rejection sampling (default: greedy). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_SAMPLING

parameters.name: Draft UBatch Size
parameters.description: NEW (v0.7.0): physical maximum batch size of the draft context; use a smaller value to spare VRAM (default: 0 = same as -ub). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_UBATCH

parameters.name: Draft P Split
parameters.description: Speculative decoding split probability (default: 0.10). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_P_SPLIT

parameters.name: Spec Default Config
parameters.description: Enable the default speculative decoding config

parameters.name: Model Draft
parameters.description: Draft model for speculative decoding (default: unused). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_MODEL

parameters.name: HF Repo Draft
parameters.description: Same as --hf-repo, but for the draft model. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_HF_REPO

parameters.name: GPU Layers Draft
parameters.description: Max. draft model layers in VRAM: number, 'auto' or 'all' (default: auto). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_N_GPU_LAYERS_DRAFT

parameters.name: Device Draft
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of devices for the draft model (default: follows --device)

parameters.name: Cache Type K Draft
parameters.description: KV cache data type for K for the draft model / MTP head (default: f16). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_K

parameters.name: Cache Type V Draft
parameters.description: KV cache data type for V for the draft model / MTP head (default: f16). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_V

parameters.name: Override Tensor Draft
parameters.description: Override tensor buffer type for the draft model

parameters.name: CPU MoE Draft
parameters.description: Keep all MoE weights in the CPU for the draft model. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_CPU_MOE

parameters.name: N CPU MoE Draft
parameters.description: Keep the MoE weights of the first N layers in the CPU for the draft model. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_CPU_MOE

parameters.name: Threads Draft
parameters.description: Threads used by the draft model during generation (default: same as --threads)

parameters.name: Threads Batch Draft
parameters.description: Threads used by the draft model for batch processing (default: same as --threads-draft)

parameters.name: No Draft Backend Sampling
parameters.description: Do not offload draft sampling to the backend (default: offload enabled). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_BACKEND_SAMPLING

parameters.name: N-gram Mod Min
parameters.description: Minimum number of n-gram tokens for ngram-based speculative decoding (default: 48)

parameters.name: N-gram Mod Max
parameters.description: Maximum number of n-gram tokens for ngram-based speculative decoding (default: 64)

parameters.name: N-gram Mod Match
parameters.description: ngram-mod lookup length (default: 24)

parameters.name: N-gram Simple Size N
parameters.description: Lookup n-gram length for ngram-simple (default: 12)

parameters.name: N-gram Simple Size M
parameters.description: Draft m-gram length for ngram-simple (default: 48)

parameters.name: N-gram Simple Min Hits
parameters.description: Minimum hits for ngram-simple (default: 1)

parameters.name: N-gram Map-K Size N
parameters.description: Lookup n-gram length for ngram-map-k (default: 12)

parameters.name: N-gram Map-K Size M
parameters.description: Draft m-gram length for ngram-map-k (default: 48)

parameters.name: N-gram Map-K Min Hits
parameters.description: Minimum hits for ngram-map-k (default: 1)

parameters.name: N-gram Map-K4V Size N
parameters.description: Lookup n-gram length for ngram-map-k4v (default: 12)

parameters.name: N-gram Map-K4V Size M
parameters.description: Draft m-gram length for ngram-map-k4v (default: 48)

parameters.name: N-gram Map-K4V Min Hits
parameters.description: Minimum hits for ngram-map-k4v (default: 1)

parameters.name: Synthetic Acceptance Length
parameters.description: Benchmarking only: target mean synthetic acceptance length, including the target token. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_SYNTH_LEN

parameters.name: Synthetic Acceptance Rates
parameters.description: Benchmarking only: comma-separated per-position synthetic acceptance probabilities P0,P1,... Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_SYNTH_RATES

parameters.name: Lookup Cache Static
parameters.description: Path to static lookup cache for lookup decoding (not updated by generation)

parameters.name: Lookup Cache Dynamic
parameters.description: Path to dynamic lookup cache for lookup decoding (updated by generation)

parameters.name: Draft CPU Mask
parameters.description: Draft model CPU affinity mask (hex). Complements --spec-draft-cpu-range (default: same as --cpu-mask)

parameters.name: Draft CPU Range
parameters.description: Range of CPUs for draft model affinity, lo-hi. Complements --spec-draft-cpu-mask

parameters.name: Draft CPU Strict
parameters.description: Use strict CPU placement for the draft model (default: same as --cpu-strict)

parameters.name: Draft Priority
parameters.description: Draft process/thread priority: 0-normal, 1-medium, 2-high, 3-realtime (default: 0)

parameters.name: Draft Poll
parameters.description: Use polling to wait for draft model work (default: same as --poll)

parameters.name: Draft CPU Mask Batch
parameters.description: Draft model CPU affinity mask for batch processing (default: same as --cpu-mask)

parameters.name: Draft CPU Strict Batch
parameters.description: Use strict CPU placement for draft batch processing (default: --spec-draft-cpu-strict)

parameters.name: Draft Priority Batch
parameters.description: Draft batch process/thread priority: 0-normal, 1-medium, 2-high, 3-realtime (default: 0)

parameters.name: Draft Poll Batch
parameters.description: Use polling to wait for draft batch work (default: --spec-draft-poll)

parameters.name: Cache RAM
parameters.description: Maximum host-RAM prompt cache size in MiB (default: 8192, 0 for decision models, -1 = no limit, 0 = disable). Speeds up resuming long conversations. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_RAM

parameters.name: Context Checkpoints
parameters.description: Max number of context checkpoints per slot (default: 32). Needed by SWA/hybrid models (Gemma, Qwen3.x) to avoid full prompt re-processing. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CTX_CHECKPOINTS

parameters.name: Checkpoint Min Step
parameters.description: Minimum spacing between context checkpoints in tokens (default: 8192, 0 = no minimum). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CHECKPOINT_MIN_SPACING_NT

parameters.name: No Cache Idle Slots
parameters.description: Do not save idle slots to the prompt cache on new tasks (default: enabled, requires cache-ram). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_IDLE_SLOTS

parameters.name: No Cache Prompt
parameters.description: Disable prompt caching (default: enabled). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_PROMPT

parameters.name: Cache Reuse
parameters.description: Min chunk size to attempt reusing from the cache via KV shifting, requires prompt caching (default: 0). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_REUSE

parameters.name: Slot Prompt Similarity
parameters.description: How much the prompt of a request must match the prompt of a slot to use that slot (default: 0.10, 0.0 = disabled)

parameters.name: Slot Save Path
parameters.description: Path to save slot KV cache (default: disabled)

parameters.name: Predict Tokens
parameters.description: Number of tokens to predict (default: -1 = infinity). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_N_PREDICT

parameters.name: Keep Tokens
parameters.description: Number of tokens to keep from the initial prompt (default: 0, -1 = all)

parameters.name: Context Shift
parameters.description: Use context shift on infinite text generation (default: disabled). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CONTEXT_SHIFT

parameters.name: No Warmup
parameters.description: Skip warming up the model with an empty run (default: warmup enabled)

parameters.name: No Cont Batching
parameters.description: Disable continuous batching (default: enabled). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_CONT_BATCHING

parameters.name: Reverse Prompt
parameters.description: Halt generation at PROMPT, return control in interactive mode

parameters.name: Special
parameters.description: Special tokens output enabled (default: false)

parameters.name: SPM Infill
parameters.description: Use Suffix/Prefix/Middle pattern for infill (default: disabled)

parameters.name: Pooling
parameters.description: Pooling type for embeddings, model default if unspecified. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_POOLING

parameters.name: Embedding Normalize
parameters.description: Normalisation for embeddings (default: 2) (-1=none, 0=max absolute int16, 1=taxicab, 2=euclidean, >2=p-norm)

parameters.name: LoRA
parameters.description: Path to LoRA adapter (comma-separated values to load multiple adapters)

parameters.name: LoRA Scaled
parameters.description: LoRA adapter with user defined scaling. Format: FNAME:SCALE,...

parameters.name: LoRA Init Without Apply
parameters.description: Load LoRA adapters without applying them (apply later via POST /lora-adapters)

parameters.name: Control Vector
parameters.description: Add a control vector (comma-separated values to add multiple)

parameters.name: Control Vector Scaled
parameters.description: Add a control vector with user defined scaling. Format: FNAME:SCALE,...

parameters.name: Control Vector Layer Range
parameters.description: Layer range to apply the control vector(s) to, start and end inclusive. Format: START END

parameters.name: Model URL
parameters.description: Model download url (default: unused). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_MODEL_URL

parameters.name: HF Repo
parameters.description: Hugging Face model repository <user>/<model>[:quant]; quant defaults to Q4_K_M. mmproj is downloaded automatically if available. Example: ggml-org/GLM-4.7-Flash-GGUF:Q4_K_M. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_HF_REPO

parameters.name: HF File
parameters.description: Hugging Face model file. Overrides the quant in --hf-repo. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_HF_FILE

parameters.name: HF Token
parameters.description: Hugging Face access token (default: value from HF_TOKEN environment variable)

parameters.name: Docker Repo
parameters.description: Docker Hub model repository [<repo>/]<model>[:quant], e.g. gemma3. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_DOCKER_REPO

parameters.name: Offline
parameters.description: Offline mode: forces use of cache, prevents network access

parameters.name: Cache List
parameters.description: Show list of models in cache and exit

parameters.name: MMProj
parameters.description: Path to a multimodal projector file. Can be omitted with -hf. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ

parameters.name: MMProj URL
parameters.description: URL to a multimodal projector file. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ_URL

parameters.name: No MMProj
parameters.description: Do not use a multimodal projector (useful with -hf). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ_AUTO

parameters.name: No MMProj Offload
parameters.description: Do not offload the multimodal projector to GPU (saves VRAM for context). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ_OFFLOAD

parameters.name: MMProj Device
parameters.description: Device for the multimodal projector, e.g. CUDA1 (none = do not offload, default: follows --device). Environment variable: MTMD_BACKEND_DEVICE

parameters.name: Image Min Tokens
parameters.description: Minimum tokens per image for dynamic-resolution vision models (default: read from model)

parameters.name: Image Max Tokens
parameters.description: Maximum tokens per image for dynamic-resolution vision models; lower = faster image prompts (default: read from model)

parameters.name: MTMD Batch Max Tokens
parameters.description: Maximum number of image tokens per batch when encoding images (default: 1024)

parameters.name: Video FPS
parameters.description: Target video frame rate (default: 4.0)

parameters.name: Video Timestamp Interval
parameters.description: Interval in milliseconds between text timestamps (default: 5000)

parameters.name: Video FFmpeg Dir
parameters.description: Directory containing ffmpeg and ffprobe (default: search in PATH)

parameters.name: Media Path
parameters.description: Directory for loading local media files via file:// URLs (default: disabled)

parameters.name: Temperature
parameters.description: Temperature (default: 0.80)

parameters.name: Top K
parameters.description: Top-k sampling (default: 40, 0 = disabled)

parameters.name: Top P
parameters.description: Top-p sampling (default: 0.95, 1.0 = disabled)

parameters.name: Min P
parameters.description: Min-p sampling (default: 0.05, 0.0 = disabled)

parameters.name: Presence Penalty
parameters.description: Repeat alpha presence penalty (default: 0.00, 0.0 = disabled)

parameters.name: Repeat Penalty
parameters.description: Penalize repeat sequence of tokens (default: 1.00, 1.0 = disabled)

parameters.name: Backend Sampling
parameters.description: NEW: run sampling on the GPU backend (experimental, default: disabled). Can raise t/s on fast GPUs. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_BACKEND_SAMPLING

parameters.name: Samplers
parameters.description: Samplers used for generation, in order, separated by ';'

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.description: RNG seed (default: -1, use random seed for -1)

parameters.name: Sampling Seq
parameters.description: Simplified sequence for samplers (default: edskypmxt)

parameters.name: Ignore EOS
parameters.description: Ignore end of stream token and continue generating (implies --logit-bias EOS-inf)

parameters.name: Top N Sigma
parameters.description: Top-n-sigma sampling (default: -1.00 = disabled)

parameters.name: XTC Probability
parameters.description: XTC probability (default: 0.00 = disabled)

parameters.name: XTC Threshold
parameters.description: XTC threshold (default: 0.10, 1.0 = disabled)

parameters.name: Typical
parameters.description: Locally typical sampling, parameter p (default: 1.00 = disabled)

parameters.name: Adaptive-P Target
parameters.description: NEW adaptive-p sampler: select tokens near this probability (0.0-1.0; negative = disabled)

parameters.name: Adaptive-P Decay
parameters.description: Adaptive-p decay rate (0.0-0.99, default: 0.90)

parameters.name: Repeat Last N
parameters.description: Last n tokens to consider for penalize (default: 64, 0 = disabled)

parameters.name: Frequency Penalty
parameters.description: Repeat alpha frequency penalty (default: 0.00 = disabled)

parameters.name: DRY Multiplier
parameters.description: DRY sampling multiplier (default: 0.00 = disabled)

parameters.name: DRY Base
parameters.description: DRY sampling base value (default: 1.75)

parameters.name: DRY Allowed Length
parameters.description: Allowed length for DRY sampling (default: 2)

parameters.name: DRY Penalty Last N
parameters.description: DRY penalty for the last n tokens (default: 64, 0 = disable)

parameters.name: DRY Sequence Breaker
parameters.description: Add sequence breaker for DRY sampling, clearing out default breakers; use "none" for no breakers

parameters.name: Dynatemp Range
parameters.description: Dynamic temperature range (default: 0.00 = disabled)

parameters.name: Dynatemp Exp
parameters.description: Dynamic temperature exponent (default: 1.00)

parameters.name: Mirostat
parameters.description: Mirostat sampling (0 = disabled, 1 = Mirostat, 2 = Mirostat 2.0)

parameters.name: Mirostat LR
parameters.description: Mirostat learning rate, parameter eta (default: 0.10)

parameters.name: Mirostat Ent
parameters.description: Mirostat target entropy, parameter tau (default: 5.00)

parameters.name: Logit Bias
parameters.description: Modify the likelihood of a token, e.g. 15043+1 to increase ' Hello'

parameters.name: Grammar
parameters.description: BNF-like grammar to constrain generations

parameters.name: Grammar File
parameters.description: File to read grammar from

parameters.name: JSON Schema
parameters.description: JSON schema to constrain generations, e.g. {} for any JSON object

parameters.name: JSON Schema File
parameters.description: File containing a JSON schema to constrain generations

parameters.name: No Escape
parameters.description: Do not process escape sequences (\n, \r, \t, \', \", \\) (default: processed)

parameters.name: ROPE Scaling
parameters.description: RoPE frequency scaling method, defaults to linear unless specified by the model

parameters.name: ROPE Scale
parameters.description: RoPE context scaling factor, expands context by a factor of N

parameters.name: ROPE Freq Base
parameters.description: RoPE base frequency, used by NTK-aware scaling (default: loaded from model)

parameters.name: ROPE Freq Scale
parameters.description: RoPE frequency scaling factor, expands context by a factor of 1/N

parameters.name: YARN Orig Ctx
parameters.description: YaRN: original context size of model (default: 0 = model training context size)

parameters.name: YARN Ext Factor
parameters.description: YaRN: extrapolation mix factor (default: -1.00, 0.0 = full interpolation)

parameters.name: YARN Attn Factor
parameters.description: YaRN: scale sqrt(t) or attention magnitude (default: -1.00)

parameters.name: YARN Beta Slow
parameters.description: YaRN: high correction dim or alpha (default: -1.00)

parameters.name: YARN Beta Fast
parameters.description: YaRN: low correction dim or beta (default: -1.00)

parameters.name: Verbosity
parameters.description: Verbosity threshold: 0 generic, 1 error, 2 warning, 3 info (default), 4 trace, 5 debug. The Tuning Wizard needs 4 to read memory stats.

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description: Set verbosity level to infinity (log all messages, useful for debugging)

parameters.name: Log Disable
parameters.description: Disable logging

parameters.name: Log File
parameters.description: Log to file. Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_LOG_FILE

parameters.name: Log JSONL
parameters.description: Log as JSONL (one JSON object per line) to stdout

parameters.name: Log Colors
parameters.description: Colored logging ('on', 'off', or 'auto')

parameters.name: Log Prefix
parameters.description: Enable prefix in log messages

parameters.name: Log Timestamps
parameters.description: Enable timestamps in log messages

parameters.name: Log Prompts Dir
parameters.description: Log prompts to directory (debugging only, default: disabled)

parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: Show version and build information and exit

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: IP address to listen, or bind to a UNIX socket if it ends with .sock (default: 127.0.0.1). Use 0.0.0.0 to expose on the LAN.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: Port to listen (default: 9931 since llama.cpp v0.7.0 / b11669; 8080 in older builds). Environment variable: LLAMA_ARG_PORT

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: Model name aliases, comma-separated (used by the API)

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: Model tags, comma-separated (informational)

parameters.name: API Key
parameters.description: API key(s) for authentication, comma-separated (default: none)

parameters.name: API Key File
parameters.description: File containing API keys, one per line (default: none)

parameters.name: Metrics
parameters.description: Enable prometheus compatible /metrics endpoint (default: disabled)

parameters.name: Props
parameters.description: Enable changing global properties via POST /props (default: disabled)

parameters.name: No Slots Endpoint
parameters.description: Disable the slots monitoring endpoint (default: enabled)

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: Server read/write timeout in seconds (default: 3600)

parameters.name: Threads HTTP
parameters.description: Number of threads used to process HTTP requests (default: -1)

parameters.name: SSE Ping Interval
parameters.description: Server SSE ping interval in seconds (-1 = disabled, default: 30)

parameters.name: Sleep Idle Seconds

parameters.name: Reasoning Budget
